# Lane 2.202, part 2: a real PostgreSQL on this computer, for tests

**Where it stood.** Four commits by the first builder (35e21cd checkLoginRole, 8291ceb the script, b40ef61 the tests, 8bf1626 record 092, T-292, `docs/operations/real-postgres.md`), never seen to run: on a machine where the session is root, `npm run test:real-postgres` failed at "make its database files".

**What I built.**

- Merge of `origin/build/stage-1` (845652d): no conflict; the type check passes after it.
- 2756c52: `start` makes the folders inside `.local` on the way to `.local/pg` passable (not readable) for the server's own `postgres` account; mkdir had made `.local` for root alone, so initdb could not read its password file. New rule `foldersOnTheWay` in `scripts/real-postgres-rules.mjs`, its test in `tests/real-postgres-rules.test.mjs` (11 tests pass). Proof: `npm run test:real-postgres` passes here, 5 files, 24 tests, PostgreSQL 16.15.

**The Done test, sentence by sentence.**

- The command starts the server: holds (it prints "Started a throw-away PostgreSQL 16.15 ... 22 migrations applied", `lifecycle.test.ts`).
- `checkLoginRole` passes for `app_login` and names each fault of the owner: holds (`login-roles.test.ts`).
- With no league set `app_login` sees no league: holds (`league-fence.test.ts`).
- Two connections at once each keep their own league: holds (`league-fence.test.ts`).
- The owner cannot `set role app_user`: holds (`login-roles.test.ts`, also cannot open the app's transaction).
- A planted fault (the fence off on one table) fails a test: holds (`planted-fault.test.ts`, names the table, passes again with the fence back).
- `stop` leaves no process and a clean `git status`: holds (`lifecycle.test.ts`; after the run `pgrep postgres` found nothing and `.local/pg` was gone).
- Without PostgreSQL the command fails naming what is missing: holds (`tests/real-postgres-rules.test.mjs`, also for openssl; it never skips).

**What is left, in order.** Nothing of the Done test. For the lead: (1) review (area 7; area 5 reads the role checks in `packages/database/src/db/check-login-role.ts` and `tests/real-postgres/login-roles.test.ts`); (2) the command joins GitHub's check only after the lead has seen GitHub's machines run it (step 2.99, after lane 2.191; `.github/workflows/ci.yml` not touched); (3) `docs/operations/real-postgres.md` could say in one line that, run as root, the server runs as the `postgres` account.

**Technical choices.** Only search permission (`o+x`, `g+x`) is added, and only to folders inside the repository's `.local`, and only when the server runs as another account; nothing outside the repository is changed.

**Not run.** `npm run verify`, the whole suite and the browser tests (house rules); GitHub's answer was not awaited.
